role: The end crystal on the obsidian pillars: heals the dragon, and when hit explodes with a size 6 blast that can chain into other crystals.

members.name: innerRotation
members.note: incremented each tick; the constructor's rand.nextInt(100000) draw is dragon_crystal_init and seedworld.c:sw_crystal's crystal_rotation

members.name: health
members.note: init 5, set to 0 on the first hit

members.name: EntityEnderCrystal
members.note: health 5, innerRotation rand(100000), ids and UUID; the 2.0F box is serverreplay.c sr_crystal_box; preventEntitySpawning blocks a placement into the crystal's box on the server (serverreplay.c sr_place_entity_in) and in the client's prediction (pickobj.c pickobj_client_prevents); ent-endplace-s1

members.name: EntityEnderCrystal
members.note: health 5, innerRotation rand(100000), ids and UUID; the 2.0F box is serverreplay.c sr_crystal_box; preventEntitySpawning blocks a placement into the crystal's box on the server (serverreplay.c sr_place_entity_in) and in the client's prediction (pickobj.c pickobj_client_prevents); ent-endplace-s1

members.name: canTriggerWalking
members.note: returns false; no walking trigger in the ported surfaces

members.name: entityInit
members.note: dataWatcher 8 (health) is a client sync channel; the native state carries health directly

members.name: onUpdate
members.note: prev position, innerRotation++, and the set-fire-block-if-missing check (block id 51) under WorldProviderEnd. The fire goes to the End's world whether or not the dragon is loaded (serverreplay.c sr_end_update gives the dragon state the End's world before a crystal ticks).

members.name: writeEntityToNBT
members.note: vanilla writes nothing of its own; endfight_crystal_nbt states exactly that

members.name: canBeCollidedWith
members.note: true: the projectile lists and the client pick (pickobj.c tracks the crystal to the client)

members.name: attackEntityFrom
members.note: first hit sets health 0, dead, then the size 6 explosion; the probe path is csrc/engine/dragon.c:dragon_crystal_attack

notes: The explosion itself (World.createExplosion(null, x, y, z, 6.0F, true)) is csrc/engine/serverreplay.c:sr_end_crystal_explode with the chain through other crystals. end-arrival-s1 covers the crystals healing the dragon, end-crystals-s1 three crystals shot with a full bow; test_dragon.c drives dragon_crystal_tick and dragon_crystal_attack against the oracle/tests/end-* recordings. Not verified: whether the crystal's fire-block tick runs inside the same world pass as the dragon's tick in every scene. Verification only (triage 2026-09-25, out/plan/remaining-2026-09-25.md): verification only: the member is ported but no scene pins it; covered by the verify list, not a port. It stays partial until a recording pins it. lane/idxentity: ent-endplace-s1 (from the cp-end-s1 checkpoint) places a block into a crystal's box, refused on both sides (it was placed natively, the dragon's box too), then a block beside it. Since lane/endreturn (2026-09-27): a snowball and an egg destroy a crystal (end-throw-s42), a TNT's and a bed's blast destroy one (end-tnt-s42, end-bed-s42), and the crystal blast's push on the player lands on the living twin too, so the entity pass's copy-back keeps it (serverreplay.c eb_player_motion; end-throw-s42 row 25). Crystal-on-crystal chains cannot happen on seed 42: its closest pair is 12.37 blocks apart, past a power-6 blast's 12-block entity reach.
